item.description: This is my new series on Prompt Engineering and it’s different from everything else out there. Most blogs give you templates: “Try this prompt!” or “Use these 10 techniques!” That’s not what we’re doing here.

item.title: Prompt Engineering From First Principles: The Mechanics They Don't Teach You - Part 2
item.description: In Part 1, we established a fundamental truth: LLMs are probability engines, not reasoning machines. They don’t “know” anything; they predict the next likely token based on patterns seen during training.
